_what: Pixel readings for crane_height.py: the nave's FAR overhead crane in photo 007 (iPhone 14 Pro Max, 3x telephoto, 77 mm-eq, 4032 x 2688, 2026-08-24 17:00:15 +04, taken from the entry-end crane 8 s before photo 004). The photograph is the owner's and stays private; these are only numbers read off it.
how_read: 2026-09-29, by eye on full-resolution crops with a 20-50 px grid (session scratchpad hall0929/cropg.py), and for the girder's top and bottom edges by the yellow-minus-blue edge profile of 21-px-wide columns (the strongest rise/fall). Full-resolution pixel coordinates, (x, v), v down.

fx_px.how: EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm 77 on the phone's native 4:3 frame (diagonal 5040 px): 77 / 43.27 * 5040 = 8969; the tele's 9.0 mm on 1.0 um pixels = 9000. +-1 %.

camera_z_m.how: the crane camera: photo 032's fit puts it at z 50.2 (moxir-hall-features-2026-09-28.json); VGGT (2026-09-27 run) puts 004 3.3 m further along the hall than 032, and 007 was taken 8 s from 004 at the same place.

wall_inner_z_m.how: the far end wall's inside face: 18 x 6 m grid (OSM way 289841504, 108.4 m) + 0.5 m, as hall.py draws it

camera_h_m.how: photo 032 fit 6.88 m; VGGT 7.1 m for 004 (VGGT ran ~6 % high against the 032 fit); the photographer stood under the crane girders (004: both girders overhead), so 6.5-7.4 m

rail_span_m.how: GOST 534-78 / 25711-83 overhead cranes: rail span L_k = building span 24 m - 2*lambda, lambda 0.5-1.0 m (0.75 m usual up to 50 t -> 22.5 m)

_level_edge: the bridge girder's top edge (edge profile at x 1100, 1750, 3000): a level line in the world, slope -0.0168 = 0.96 deg roll
_rail_x_px: the end trucks' wheels on the rails: left truck wheels x 640-720 (centre 680), right truck x 3580-3625 (centre 3600)
_floor_at_wall: the floor line at the foot of the far end wall: the sill of the steel double door (x 1809-1987) and the wall base left of it

rail_top.what: top of the crane rail = where the end trucks' wheels sit on the runway girders, both ends

bridge_bottom_mid.what: underside of the bridge girder at mid-span (edge profile, x 1750 and 2250)

bridge_top_mid.what: top of the bridge girder at mid-span

bridge_bottom_end.what: underside of the girder near the left end truck (the girder is shallower at its ends)

cab_bottom.what: bottom of the operator's cab (yellow-black striped), hung under the right end

hook_block_top.what: the hoist's hook block under the trolley (trolley at x 1850-2150 on top of the bridge)

hook_low.what: the lowest point of the hook and its chain as parked on 2026-08-24

wall_top_under_roof.what: where the far end wall's light plaster ends under the roof structure (a check of the space frame's bottom chord, NOT a clean edge)

far_gate.what: the dark gate opening in the far end wall (its sill is hidden; the floor line is taken from the door)

steel_door.what: the grey steel double door left of the gate
